# Electrik

> Laravel SaaS starter kit: auth, teams, Stripe billing, Slate 3 UI.

- Site: https://electrik.dev
- Install: https://electrik.dev/install
- License: https://electrik.dev/license
- Pricing: https://electrik.dev/pricing
- FAQ: https://electrik.dev/faq
- GitHub: https://github.com/electrikhq/electrik
- Packagist: https://packagist.org/packages/electrik/electrik
- UI kit docs: https://slate.electrik.dev
- Demo: https://demo.electrik.dev

## Quick install

composer require electrik/electrik:^5.0@alpha
php artisan electrik:install

## License summary

BSL 1.1 with a free Additional Use Grant for personal, educational, open-source, and pre-revenue indie use.
Commercial use by companies requires a separate commercial license. Full features in source for both lanes.
